description: This file contains utility functions for command-line argument parsing and environment variable reading, including functions to consume and process flags of different types (string, integer, float, boolean) and to parse argument arrays based on provided specifications.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads an environment variable by name, trims it, parses it as a float, and returns the number if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Consumes a string flag from argv at a specified index, returning the next index and the value if the flag matches.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Consumes a string list flag from argv at a specified index, returning the next index and the value if the flag matches.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Consumes an integer flag from argv, ensuring it meets optional minimum constraints; returns the next index and parsed value.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Consumes a float flag from argv, with options for minimum value and inclusion, returning the next index and parsed value.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag handler for string flags that updates target object with the flag value.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag handler for string list flags that appends the flag value to target object.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a handler for integer flags with validation options, updating target object with parsed integer.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a handler for float flags with validation options, updating target object.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a handler that sets a boolean flag in target object.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments array with provided specifications and options, handling flags accordingly.
